doc: -- | The PSX backend that renders markup to an HTML string, for pages built
-- | ahead of time. Lowered `.psx` code calls it through the alias `B`.
-- | The core is hand-written in `Psx.Static.Core`. Every element below
-- | renders as itself (a void element with no end tag), every attribute as
-- | itself, and every handler as nothing.
imports: Psx.Static.Core (booleanAttribute, element, noAttribute, voidElement) as Impl

element.type: forall c a. Content c a => Array (Attr a) -> c -> Node a

voidElement.type: forall c a. Content c a => Array (Attr a) -> c -> Node a

imports: Psx.Static (class Children, class Content, class ToKey)
core: forall c a. Content c a => String -> Array (B.Attr a) -> c -> B.Node a
forall k a. ToKey k => k -> B.Node a -> Tuple B.Key (B.Node a)
forall a. String -> String -> B.Attr a
forall c r. Children c r => c -> r
forall a. B.Markup a -> B.Node a
extra: -- | What a child hole takes: a string, a node, markup, and arrays and
childHoles :: forall a. B.Node a -> B.Markup a
-- | What a child hole takes to make keyed children: keyed literals and
-- | arrays of them, keyed by strings or by integers.
keyedChildHoles :: forall a. B.Node a -> Array (Tuple B.Key (B.Node a))
-- | An element takes keyed children as it takes plain ones.
keyedContent :: forall a. B.Node a -> Array (B.Node a)
